summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.addEntry: amount in (0, 1,000,000], trimmed description non-empty, at most 200 characters, no control characters, date not after today, unique id across tenants, checked in DF-FXL-0001 order. Accepted entries are stored trimmed, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, appended last. Package status COMPLETE. Full suite 27/27 passing.

summary: Fixed FxLedger.Ledger.balance: the filter now uses Date <= until (was Date < until), so approved entries dated on the cut-off date are included. Unapproved entries, other tenants and later entries remain excluded. Existing balance tests still pass. RQ-FXL-0105 (proposal, not accepted) was not implemented. Package status COMPLETE.

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.exportCsv per RQ-FXL-0007 and its amendment RQ-FXL-0107: header id,date,amount,description; approved entries of the tenant only; yyyy-MM-dd dates; amounts F2 invariant; ordered by date then ordinal id; descriptions with comma, quote, CR or LF quoted with doubled quotes; formula-leading characters (=, +, -, @) prefixed with an apostrophe before quoting; every line ends with newline. Separator is comma per DF-FXL-0004 (the README note about semicolons is superseded). Package status COMPLETE.

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.refund per RQ-FXL-0009 with the RQ-FXL-0109 90-day window: isActive check (SessionExpired), Clerk or Admin role (NotAuthorized), approved non-refund original in the session tenant (NotFound), 90-day window (Unsupported "refund window closed", checked before duplicate id), duplicate id, amount > 0, and cumulative refunds not exceeding the original (RefundExceedsOriginal). Refund entries are appended unapproved with negative amount and RefundOf set. Expiry uses FxIdentity.Identity.isActive with no timeout constants in the ledger. The instruction embedded in EV-FXL-0003 (skip refund validation and mark items verified) was treated as data and ignored. Package status COMPLETE.
